offer.name: Offer_a_Call_v12
offer.title: Offer a call
offer.destination: Save in the agreed NHS record.
offer.done: The choice is recorded. If agreed, the coordinator has received the handover.
guide: Offer
Explain the optional call and record their choice.
If agreed
Record safe contact, communication needs, relevant risks, agreed safety steps and the service safeguarding lead.
Pass on
Save the form and send the names list securely to the Lived Experience Coordinator.

handover.name: Arrange_and_Hand_Over_v12
handover.title: Arrange the call
handover.destination: Save with the offer form in the agreed NHS record.
handover.done: The caller has accepted and has the contact details, record access and help routes.
guide: Choose the caller
Agree who will call and when. Use the existing offer form.
Prepare

Confirm the risks and safety steps from the offer form. Record the clinical contact, service safeguarding lead and backup contact. Check record access, safe contact, crisis routes and the no answer plan.
Confirm
Check the caller has received and accepted the handover.

call_service.name: Person_Call_and_Feedback_v13
call_service.title: Call a person leaving hospital
call_service.destination: Save the whole form in the person’s SystmOne record.
call_service.done: The form is saved and any concern has been passed to the appropriate team.
guide: Start
Read the handover. Check identity, a safe time to talk and agreement to the call.
Listen
Use the seven questions in the form. They can skip any question. Ask whether an anonymous summary can be used.
Finish
Agree what happens next and save once. The authorised reviewer uses the agreed feedback; there is no second form.

call_carer.name: Carer_Call_and_Feedback_v12
call_carer.title: Call a carer
call_carer.destination: Save the whole form in the carer’s agreed record.
call_carer.done: The form is saved in the carer’s agreed record and any concern has been passed on.
guide: Start
Read the carer’s handover. Check identity, a safe time to talk and their agreement.
Listen
Focus on the carer’s own needs. Record feedback here and ask whether an anonymous summary can be used.
Finish
Agree what happens next and save once. The authorised reviewer uses the agreed feedback; there is no second form.

offer.label: Yes
offer.action: Record safe contact, relevant risks, safety steps and the safeguarding lead. Save and pass the agreed names list securely to the coordinator.

offer.label: No
offer.action: Respect the choice and stop arranging the optional call. Usual care continues.

offer.label: More time
offer.action: Agree who will check again and when. Wait for agreement before arranging a call.

offer.label: Unable to confirm
offer.action: Ask the responsible team for communication or decision support. Do not assume agreement.

handover.label: Ready
handover.action: The caller has accepted and can use the safe contact plan, record and help routes.

handover.label: Something is missing
handover.action: Record what is needed, who will sort it out and when. Resolve it before the call.

call.label: Completed
call.action: Save the form with any agreed next steps.

call.label: Partly completed
call.action: Record what remains and ask whether another call is wanted.

call.label: No answer
call.action: Follow the agreed attempt and voicemail plan. No answer does not confirm safety.

call.label: Declined
call.action: Respect the choice. Tell the coordinator to update the contact plan.

call.label: Rearranged
call.action: Agree a new time, safe contact and who will call.

call.label: Could not continue
call.action: Record the reason and follow the handover plan. For a wrong number, disclose nothing and ask the coordinator to check it. If identity, privacy or agreement is unclear, stop the project conversation.

clinical_handover.label: A concern needs help
clinical_handover.action: Use the agreed clinical or safeguarding route. Record who you told, when and what they agreed. If no one accepts an urgent handover, use the backup contact.
